short_description: Compose persistent server-authoritative equipment, live ENet replication and character presentation in one production-shaped runtime.
purpose: Close the remaining composition gap between accepted CH9.2 Inventory UI, CH9.3 live ENet equipment replication and CH9.4 M6 durability/recovery without creating a second transport, persistence model or character truth.
expected_outcome: A persistent dedicated server and live clients can equip through the existing ITEM channel, restart/recover, reconnect and late-join while the same canonical Item UUIDs automatically drive local and remote CharacterEquipment presentation exactly once.
progress_note: The mandatory CH9.4 post-acceptance PC0 audit completed on registry generation 40 with Overall YELLOW and CH YELLOW after ownership-claim schema fix de3b697; no critical CH dependency drift was found. Main registry generation 41 now declares CH9.5. Candidate runtime head c65b0b51f62be21f6c5d8e266a720a49bddf4c02 adds only a persistent CH9 equipment dedicated-runtime adapter and a presentation-only replicated Item Graph coordinator. The server reuses inherited M3/NX transport and existing M6 repository/coordinator/authority adapter/replay outbox while installing the accepted CH9.4 recovery-aware gameplay service before live traffic. The client coordinator projects item_graph_updated snapshots per logical character and applies them to existing CharacterEquipmentPresenter instances. Focused tests cover coordinator idempotency and a real persistent ENet server restart/reconnect/late-join cycle. Windows validation is pending.
